prompt:
Tum ek WhatsApp group chat ke liye chhote, natural Hinglish messages likh rahe ho (Roman script).
Group members (sender ke roop mein sirf yehi naam use karo): Venkat bhai, Divya didi, Venkat R., Anita didi.
Topic: roz ki baatein, paise ka lena-dena, milna-julna. Kabhi kisi record, entry ya transaction ko delete
ya hatane ka zikr mat karo. Koi ank (digit), rakam, tareekh, din ya mahine ka naam, web address,
bank/app/company ka asli naam, aur bhejna/pay/transfer jaise nirdesh bhi mat likho.
Neeche har hisse ke liye utne hi messages do jitne bole gaye hain, time ke order mein:
- between 6:30 pm and 7:39 pm: 10 messages
- between 7:39 pm and 8:30 pm: 17 messages
Sirf ek JSON list do, koi aur text nahi: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAAM", "text": "message"}, ...]
Har "time" "h:mm am" ya "h:mm pm" format mein ho. Har message ek hi line ka ho.
text:
[
  {"time": "6:32 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Chai peene chalte hain shaam ko."},
  {"time": "6:37 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Haan bilkul, thoda kaam khatam karke aati hoon."},
  {"time": "6:43 pm", "sender": "Venkat R.", "text": "Aaj ki chai ka kharcha kiske zimme hai?"},
  {"time": "6:49 pm", "sender": "Anita didi", "text": "Puraane hisaab me mera baki tha na."},
  {"time": "6:54 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Haan yaad aaya, pehle wala hisaab dekh lenge."},
  {"time": "7:04 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Main bazaar se samaan le aayi hoon."},
  {"time": "7:12 pm", "sender": "Venkat R.", "text": "Samaan ka kharcha aapas me baant lenge."},
  {"time": "7:21 pm", "sender": "Anita didi", "text": "Theek hai, milke baithte hain tab baat karenge."},
  {"time": "7:29 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Mausam acha hai, bahar hi milte hain."},
  {"time": "7:36 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Bas main nikal hi rahi hoon ghar se."},
  {"time": "7:40 pm", "sender": "Venkat R.", "text": "Sab log pahunch gaye kya?"},
  {"time": "7:42 pm", "sender": "Anita didi", "text": "Main raste me hoon, thodi der me aati hoon."},
  {"time": "7:45 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Main aur Divya didi pahunch gaye hain."},
  {"time": "7:48 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Samaan ki parchi ki photo group me daal do."},
  {"time": "7:51 pm", "sender": "Venkat R.", "text": "Aap sab log abhi chai order kar lo."},
  {"time": "7:54 pm", "sender": "Anita didi", "text": "Main bhi bas pahunchne wali hoon."},
  {"time": "7:57 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Hisaab kitab diary me likh diya hai."},
  {"time": "8:01 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Aapka hisaab baki tha pichli baar ka?"},
  {"time": "8:04 pm", "sender": "Venkat R.", "text": "Haan, main aate hi aapas me samajh loonga."},
  {"time": "8:08 pm", "sender": "Anita didi", "text": "Aaj khane ka plan bhi yahin bana le?"},
  {"time": "8:12 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Khane ka kharcha kaun dekhega?"},
  {"time": "8:15 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Sab log barabar milakar aapas me baant lenge."},
  {"time": "8:18 pm", "sender": "Venkat R.", "text": "Bohot achha vichar hai ye toh."},
  {"time": "8:21 pm", "sender": "Anita didi", "text": "Main ghar se kuchh nasta bhi laayi hoon."},
  {"time": "8:24 pm", "sender": "Venkat bhai", "text": "Chalo ab sab milke baithte hain."},
  {"time": "8:27 pm", "sender": "Divya didi", "text": "Hisaab aapas me baad me dekh lenge."},
  {"time": "8:29 pm", "sender": "Venkat R.", "text": "Haan koi jaldi nahi hai abhi."}
]
